-- Keyspace and table
CREATE KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS demo WITH replication = {'class': 'SimpleStrategy', 'replication_factor': 1};
CREATE TABLE demo.users (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, name text, tags set<text>);
INSERT INTO demo.users (id, name) VALUES (uuid(), 'It''s Ann') USING TTL 86400;
SELECT name FROM demo.users WHERE id = ? LIMIT 31 ALLOW FILTERING;
